name: debloater
description: Evidence-based WordPress configuration auditing and safe, reversible debloating.

scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:main && npm run test:integration:fail-probe
scripts.test:integration:main: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/debloater php tools/phpunit-9.phar -c phpunit-wp.xml.dist
scripts.test:integration:fail-probe: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/debloater php tools/phpunit-9.phar -c phpunit-wp-fail-probe.xml.dist
scripts.env:seed: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/debloater wp eval-file tools/seed-fixture.php
scripts.test:e2e:seed: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/debloater wp eval-file tools/seed-e2e.php
scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/debloater wp i18n make-pot . languages/debloater.pot --slug=debloater --domain=debloater --exclude=tests,tools,node_modules,admin-ui,vendor,docs,dist --headers={\"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To\":\"https://github.com/scornik/debloater/issues\",\"Last-Translator\":\"\",\"Language-Team\":\"\"}
scripts.i18n:json: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/debloater wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/debloater wp plugin check debloater --format=table
scripts.test:probe-e2e: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/debloater wp eval-file tools/admin-probe-e2e.php
